subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: When a workspace ignore file exceeds the new 4 MiB limit, should skill scanning stop with a diagnostic, continue after warning, or silently scan without those ignore rules?
rationale: The byte-bound implementation is mechanically correct, but each failure policy changes user-visible scan inclusion; current code and docs do not establish which tradeoff maintainers intend.

options.title: Stop with diagnostic
options.body: Fail the affected workspace scan non-fatally with an actionable warning rather than silently scanning content the ignore file may exclude.

options.title: Warn and continue
options.body: Continue without the oversized rules but identify the skipped file and explain that additional paths may be scanned.

options.title: Silently continue
options.body: Accept the current patch behavior and treat oversized ignore files like unreadable sources with no user indication.

recommendation.title: Stop with diagnostic
recommendation.body: Fail the affected workspace scan non-fatally with an actionable warning rather than silently scanning content the ignore file may exclude.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared ignore loader and adjacent bounded-scan behavior, making them the strongest history-backed owner for this policy choice.
